Capped Liquidated Damages (LDs) || If your bank leaves FIS, for any reason, prior to end of your contract term, FIS will cap LDs at 50%, no cap on third-party solutions.

Capped Deconversion Fees || If your bank leaves FIS, for any reason, FIS will cap your FIS (not just core) deconversion fee.  This does not include image deconversion fees or any third-party deconversion fee.  Under $500M ($250,000), $500M -$1B ($350,000), $1B-$3B ($450,000), Over $3B ($600,000).
Capped FIS Image Deconversion Fees for Image Files || If your bank leaves FIS, for any reason, FIS will cap your FIS image deconversion file fees at $75 per gigabyte (GB) of data.

Capped FIS Acquisition (Convert/Merge) Fee || Under $250M ($250,000), $251M-$500M ($300,000), $501M-$1B ($400,000), $1B-$3B ($500,000), $3B-$5B ($600,000), Over $5B (custom quote required).  This includes any image conversion.  This does not include any third-party fees.

Capped Increase to FIS Bundle due to Acquisition ||  In the event your bank acquires another financial institution, FIS will increase the monthly fee on your FIS bundle by the following calculation.  This increase will take effect the month following your bank’s live convert/merge.  The calculation will be 50% of your bank’s asset growth.  Example, if your bank is $2B and you acquire a $500M financial institution, your asset growth is 25%; therefore, your monthly bundle fee will increase by 12.5% (50% of your asset growth).
FIS Conversion Training / Education || FIS will provide 17 days of on-site conversion education/training.***

FIS Conversion Training / Education || FIS will provide team of subject matter experts onsite for live weekend and one full week post live conversion for additional support, responsiveness, attention, and care.***
FIS Conversion Training / Education ||  FIS will provide client with two (2) HORIZON Health Checks over the term of our agreement.  Goal of this service is to ensure proper utilization of HORIZON.***

FIS Conversion Training / Education ||  FIS will provide client with 120 professional service hours to assist client with HORIZON 360 reports.  Goal is to ensure your bank’s most critical reports are created prior to your bank’s live conversion date on HORIZON.  This is above and beyond to standard HORIZON 360 training / education as part of your conversion.***

FIS Conversion Program and Project Management ||  FIS will provide one (1) Program Manager who will lead and oversee your bank’s overall conversion process from FIS.  In addition, for each major application (core, debit, item processing), FIS will provide a Project Manager.  This team will work in collaboration with your bank’s conversion team to ensure a successful conversion.***
Relationship and Service ||  FIS agrees to assign a Client Success Manager (CSM) at FIS, to your bank.  Your bank’s CSM will serve as your bank’s main point of contact from FIS.
FIS Annual Client Conference, Emerald ||  FIS will provide client with two (2) free annual passes to our flagship client conference, Emerald.***
Client Reference || If client is happy with our partnership, client agrees to serve as FIS client reference for other FIS prospects and clients.
